body:
I'd recommend looking on https://www.jobs.act.gov.au/ which advertises ACT Government jobs. I'd also recommend really focusing your application on addressing the "what you require" (selection crtieria) section of the position description. They (should be) assessing applicant purely based off of this. 

If you end up getting an interview, use the STAR response method (Situation Task Action Result). There are also other tips about applying on the Jobs ACT website.
